verdict.rationale: Using a tablet or spare device as an extended display is a fair question for a remote-desktop and screen-sharing product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions extended-display or second-monitor functionality, only remote access, IT management, AR assistance and pricing.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
